sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthdate FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN encounters AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Outpatient Encounter'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PATIENT) FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy' AND T1.DATE = T2.DATE

SELECT DISTINCT T3.DESCRIPTION, T4.DESCRIPTION, T5.DESCRIPTION, T2.first, T2.last FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient INNER JOIN careplans AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN procedures AS T4 ON T1.ID = T4.ENCOUNTER INNER JOIN medications AS T5 ON T1.ID = T5.ENCOUNTER WHERE T1.ID = '6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.PATIENT END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.DATE) - strftime('%J', T1.birthdate)) / 365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.PATIENT END) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN observations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Glucose'

SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND strftime('%Y', T1.START) = '2017'

SELECT MAX(T1.DATE) FROM immunizations AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PATIENT), T2.DESCRIPTION FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn'
SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.deathdate IS NULL THEN ROUND((strftime('%J', date('now')) - strftime('%J', T2.birthdate)) / 365) ELSE ROUND((strftime('%J', T2.deathdate) - strftime('%J', T2.birthdate)) / 365) END) / COUNT(T2.patient) FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension' AND T2.gender = 'M'
